title: Building reliable spaces

hero.intro: High-performance sandwich panels, steel structures, and clean room engineering—from quality materials to trusted project delivery.

about.title: Rooted in Indonesia, backed by Chinese manufacturing expertise
about.copy: Established in 2019, PT KWD PURIFIED COLOR BOARD is located in Tangerang, Indonesia, and is a subsidiary of Suzhou Luohe Group. We combine mature manufacturing management and engineering experience with local services to deliver efficient, reliable, and sustainable building envelope solutions in Southeast Asia.
about.point2: Local production and services in Tangerang
about.point3: Founded in 2019 with a professional technical team
